title: 第十七章 连胜晋级众人抱团算计第十八章 赵冲出战扬言讨公道
slug: 震惊五星灵帝被逼着撩妹
lines: 初赛持续了两天。
第一天，杨卤连赢两场，干掉祝山和陈武，让所有人都惊掉了下巴。
但更让人震惊的，还在后面。
第二天一早，杨卤的名字赫然出现在六十四强名单中。按照赛程，今天要进行三轮比赛，从六十四进三十二，再到十六强。
如果杨卤能再赢三场，他就能杀入十六强。
所有人都觉得这不可能。
然后杨卤就打了所有人的脸。
第一场，六十四进三十二。对手是二星灵王半灵境的李成——就是当初设局灌酒结果被杨卤一个人放倒的那个。
李成上台的时候还挺自信的，毕竟他自认实力比祝山和陈武都强，而且他研究过杨卤的打法，觉得自己找到了应对之策。
结果，上台不到十息，杨卤一招凝星缚加一记掌刀，直接把他拍下擂台。
全场死寂。
第二场，三十二进十六。对手是二星灵王圆满境的柳岩，此人算是内门中流砥柱，身材矮壮，主修防御，他的“金石诀”防御术法在内门是出了名的硬。
柳岩上台后，直接催动全力防御，全身覆盖一层金色岩石质感，像一座小山一样立在擂台上。
“来吧，我倒要看看你怎么破我的防。”
杨卤看了他一眼，然后抬手，轻轻一拳。
那一拳看起来轻飘飘的，就像随手一拍。但打在柳岩胸口的时候，柳岩只觉得一股不可抗拒的力量从胸口传来，整个人连退七八步，直接撞在擂台边缘的防护结界上。
防护结界被打得嗡嗡作响，柳岩整个人嵌在结界上，好半天才滑落下来。
一拳，破防。
全场再次死寂。
第三场，十六强名额争夺战，这一场是因为其他比赛有个平手，多了出来。（其实也是故意安排）
对手是二星灵王圆满境的孙洋，此人是内门前二十的老牌强者，一手“狂风快剑”使得出神入化。他看过杨卤的前几场比赛，自认为摸清了杨卤的路数，打算用极致的速度和连绵不绝的快剑来压制杨卤，不给他任何反击的机会。
孙洋上台就拔剑，身法如风，剑招如暴雨，攻势连绵不绝。
杨卤站在原地，轻松躲闪了十息，然后找到剑招衔接的一个微小空隙，一记鞭腿，把孙洋连人带剑扫下擂台。
三战，三胜，全部秒杀。
三连胜。
杨卤以令人瞠目结舌的速度，连赢三场，杀入十六强。
广场上，所有人都沉默了。
如果说之前大家还抱着“他是靠运气、靠钻空子”的心态在看待他，那现在，这些质疑全都烟消云散了。
运气或许能赢一场，或许能赢两场，但连续三场秒杀不同风格、不同修为的对手，这绝对不是什么运气。
这人，是真的强。
而且最恐怖的是，从头到尾，他只用了一招凝星缚和几招基础掌法，连正经的术法都没有施展过。
没人知道他到底还藏了多少底牌。
“这……这特么也太离谱了吧？”
“柳师兄的金石诀，竟然被他一拳打穿了？”
“孙师兄的快剑，连他的衣角都没碰到，就被扫下台了？”
content_en:
The preliminary round lasted two days.
On the first day, Yang Lu won two games in a row, killing Zhu Shan and Chen Wu, which shocked everyone.
But what’s even more shocking is yet to come.
Early the next morning, Yang Lu's name suddenly appeared on the list of the top sixty-four. According to the schedule, there will be three rounds of competition today, from 64 to 32, and then to the top 16.
If Yang Lu can win three more games, he can reach the top 16.
Everyone thinks this is impossible.
Then Yang Lu slapped everyone in the face.
In the first game, sixty-four went into thirty-two. The opponent was Li Cheng, who was in the semi-spiritual realm of the Two-Star Spirit King—the same one who had set up a trap to get him drunk, but was knocked down by Yang Lu alone.
Li Cheng was quite confident when he came on stage. After all, he thought he was stronger than Zhu Shan and Chen Wu. Moreover, he had studied Yang Lu's playing style and felt that he had found a way to deal with it.
As a result, less than ten seconds after taking the stage, Yang Lu used Ning Xing Fu and a palm knife to directly knock him off the ring.
The whole place was dead silent.
In the second game, thirty-two advanced to sixteen. The opponent is Liu Yan, who is in the perfection state of the Two-Star Spiritual King. This person is considered a mainstay of the inner sect. He is short and stocky and majors in defense. His "Golden Stone Art" defensive technique is notoriously tough in the inner sect.
After Liu Yan came on stage, he directly mobilized all his defense. His whole body was covered with a layer of golden rock texture, and he stood on the ring like a hill.
"Come on, I want to see how you break my defense."
Yang Lu glanced at him, then raised his hand and punched him lightly.
The punch looked light and airy, like a casual slap. But when it hit Liu Yan's chest, Liu Yan felt an irresistible force coming from his chest. He took seven or eight steps back and hit the protective barrier at the edge of the ring.
The protective barrier was buzzing, and Liu Yan's whole body was embedded in the barrier, and it took him a long time to slide down.
One punch, breaking the defense.
The whole place was dead silent again.
The third game, the battle for the top 16 places, this one was because there was a tie in other games, so there was an extra one. (In fact, it was also a deliberate arrangement)
The opponent is Sun Yang, who is in the perfection state of the two-star spiritual king. This person is a veteran strongman in the top 20 in the inner sect. He had watched Yang Lu's previous games and thought he had figured out Yang Lu's tactics. He planned to use extreme speed and continuous fast swords to suppress Yang Lu and not give him any chance to counterattack.
Sun Yang drew his sword as soon as he came on stage. His movements were like the wind, his sword moves were like a heavy rain, and his attacks were continuous.
Yang Lu stood on the spot and easily dodged for ten breaths. Then he found a small gap in the connection between sword moves and whipped Sun Yang off the ring with his sword.
Three battles, three wins, all killed instantly.
Three consecutive wins.
Yang Lu won three games in a row at a jaw-dropping speed and reached the top 16.
Everyone in the square was silent.
If everyone still looked at him with the mentality that "he relies on luck and taking advantage of loopholes", now, these doubts have all disappeared.
You may be lucky enough to win one game, or you may be able to win two games, but killing opponents with different styles and cultivation levels in three consecutive games is definitely not luck.
This man is really strong.
And the most terrifying thing is that from the beginning to the end, he only used one move of Condensing Star Binding and a few basic palm techniques, and never even used any serious techniques.
No one knows how many other cards he has hidden away.
"This...isn't this too fucking outrageous?"
"Senior Brother Liu's Golden Stone Technique was actually punched through by him?"
"Senior Brother Sun's quick sword didn't even touch the corner of his clothes, so he was swept off the stage?"
